product_title: Traditional Pink Lotus Pearl Latkan Pair with Shree Shubh Labh Design
product_description: Enhance your festive decorations with this beautifully handcrafted traditional latkan pair, featuring vibrant pink lotus motifs, elegant pearl embellishments, sparkling black and golden stones, and intricate beadwork. The circular top design showcases the auspicious Shubh Labh lettering in a striking red center, symbolizing prosperity, positivity, and good fortune. Adorned with graceful pearl tassels and golden accents, these decorative hangings are perfect for decorating main doors, pooja rooms, home entrances, temples, and festive backdrops. Ideal for Diwali, weddings, housewarming ceremonies, and other special occasions, this elegant pair adds a traditional and luxurious touch to your home decor.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
Keep away from water, moisture, and humidity to protect the fabric, pearls, and decorative stones.
Avoid direct sunlight for extended periods to preserve the vibrant pink color and decorative finish.
Handle the pearl tassels carefully to prevent tangling or breakage.
Avoid using harsh chemicals, detergents, or abrasive cleaning materials.
Store in a dry place in a soft cloth bag or protective box when not in use.
Keep away from sharp objects to prevent damage to the embroidery, fabric, and embellishments.
Hang securely to maintain the original shape and prevent accidental falls.
